Build clean now, exit 0. Rest of screenful just deprecation noise (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267) from bumped deps — cosmetic, no action needed.

Two real bugs fixed:
- `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on undefined.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` flag. New config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` same as `false`.
